https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/ramen-akane.s: Dog-lover Tamako is back at the ramen shop run entirely by cats, where her job isn't cooking but keeping the feline staff groomed and happy. The cosy workplace comedy returns for a second season.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/shiranui/.s: Seaside town, summer 1996: a neglected ten-year-old finds comfort in a girl deity. Sent to a children's home, he makes a wish for her, but his anger at his father slowly turns it into a curse.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/umamusume-p.en: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Beginning of a New Era
https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/umamusume-p.s: Free-spirited racer Jungle Pocket joins Tracen Academy and, under a veteran trainer, goes after the once-in-a-lifetime Triple Crown against a fearsome generation of rivals.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/live-in-the.en: Live in Theater: Battle of Tokyo
https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/live-in-the.s: A cinema re-edit of LDH JAPAN's Battle of Tokyo live shows, in which real J-pop groups double as virtual fighters in Neo Tokyo, ending with a newly animated finale.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/labyrinth/.s: When her phone cracks, a fame-hungry schoolgirl swaps places with her digital double. The fake becomes an influencer star while the real Shiori, guided by a rabbit-man, has to find her way out of a cyber maze.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/jinsei/.s: A bullied boy from a Sendai housing estate follows his father toward idol stardom. His accidental rise to fame plays out against present-day Japan's social problems.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/ramen-akane.s: Self-confessed dog person Tamako gets hired by a ramen shop staffed by cats, as caretaker for the feline crew. A gentle comedy about grooming, regulars and hot noodles.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/dead-dead-d.s: Three years after a giant alien mothership parked over Tokyo, a group of high-school girls get on with everyday life, until the strange new normal starts to fall apart.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/komada-a-wh.s: A rookie web journalist covering Japanese craft whisky helps a young distillery president try to bring back her family's lost signature blend.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/break-of-da.s: In 2049, space-mad Yuma learns that his soon-to-be-demolished housing estate is really a stranded alien spacecraft, and gets his friends together to send it home.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/ryoma-the-p.s: Training in the US, tennis prodigy Ryoma takes on street thugs to protect his classmate Sakuno. A freak collision of tennis balls sends them decades back, to his father's last championship.
https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/ryoma-the-p.romaji: Ryoma! Shinsei Gekijouban Tennis no Oujisama

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/junk-head/.s: With humanity unable to reproduce, an explorer goes down into a monster-filled underworld ruled by rebel clones to find the secret of fertility.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/seven-days-.s: A teen runs away for a week with his crush and their classmates. Holed up in an old coal factory, they end up protecting a Thai boy from immigration officers while the adults try to drag them home.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/conception/.s: Pulled into the magical world of Granvania, Itsuki must team up with twelve Star Maidens to create Star Children who can fight off invading monsters.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/okkos-inn/.s: After losing her parents in a car crash, Okko moves in with her grandmother at a countryside hot-spring inn, where friendly ghosts help her train as its future proprietress.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/oochopas/.s: Siblings Kantaro and Ann find a cute creature that turns into a different scary monster every time it eats, and everyday chaos follows for the family and their neighbours.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/chieri-and-.s: A lonely girl and her talking stuffed toy Cherry try to save a litter of newborn puppies from a crow and a monster at her grandmother's house.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/hanakappa-a.en: Hanakappa – Adventure in the Butterfly Kingdom
https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/hanakappa-a.s: When the village mothers are kidnapped, flower-headed kappa Hanakappa and his friends cross frozen mountains and burning deserts to rescue them from the Butterfly Kingdom.
https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/hanakappa-a.romaji: Eiga Hanakappa: Hanasake! Pakkaan♪ Chou no Kuni no Daibouken

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/hanakappa-2.s: Preschool edutainment series from NHK about a young kappa with a flower on his head and his daily adventures with friends in a forest village.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/night-head-.s: Two psychic brothers, locked away as children because of their powers, escape a mysterious institute after 15 years and get pulled into a new fight. An anime remake of the 1990s cult live-action drama.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/malicedoll-.s: In a dead world kept running by decaying automatons, a broken pleasure doll is turned into a flesh-and-blood human after meeting a ghostly woman.

https://www.gaga.co.jp/intls/a-li-ce-199.s: The youngest astronaut ever crash-lands 30 years in the future and finds her own son ruling the world as a dictator. She fights back with a robot and a new friend.
